instruction: Put cam-wide on air, then put cam-close on air.
notes: The core's own minimum hold is off here, so the only thing holding the shot is the min-hold plugin: a WebAssembly component answering take.before with {allow: false, reason}. The second take arrives inside eight seconds and is refused, and the reason names how long is left. Without the plugin both takes land; that is the difference this case measures. Needs a core built with --features wasm, which gmx doctor reports on the `wasm host` line.
